authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.observation: GROUP member handles are hard pointers; the original dwgadd scratch output used a soft-owner role and was correctly rejected by the existing parser.

construction: Locally generated R13/R14 drawings with a corrected bounded GROUP source graph. The source root 0x35 owns group dictionary 0x34, which contains GROUP 0x31 and its hard-pointer LINE 0x2E; ACAD APPID is 0x33. LibreDWG JSON readback independently confirms the dictionary entry, GROUP owner and member handle role. UTF-8 variants use the separately established fixed-size codepage-45 EED patch and verified object CRC. No generated drawings are committed.
checks: The existing version-aware source observer validates every bounded dictionary entry and handle role; staged output proves dictionary-to-GROUP ownership and GROUP-to-entity references. The empty-only admission restriction is removed.

The R14 EED-free nonempty baseline passed strict conversion before the change; the matching EED source was refused at opaque-output qualification. The selected ASCII and UTF-8 EED profiles now pass R14 strict and R13 explicit partial output.

ASan tests cover original and remapped source handles, EED/APPID edits, group dictionary entry and GROUP member mutations, wrong member handle role, wrong root graph, pre-inspection and late source mutations, atomic refusal and corrected same-adapter retry.
Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 reads the group dictionary EED café and integer 42, its MYGROUP record, and a LINE from (1,2,3) to (4,6,9), in ASCII and Binary output for each source version.
limits: Only the selected named GROUP and its single LINE member have independent readback here. Multiple groups, other entity types, arbitrary EED and native grouping semantics require their own evidence.
Strict R13, native dictionary duplicate/clone behavior and general DWG/DXF format support remain unqualified.
